name: robots/kami-code__dexart-release
title: DexArt laptop task (allegro hand + xArm6, Sapien)
intro: DexArt laptop task (allegro hand + xArm6, Sapien), adapted from kami-code/dexart-release. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
